repo.description: One m0saic template a day, written by an AI agent and built in public. Each morning the agent scouts the web for a media workflow that needs support, plans a media solution, writes a template (with variants), critiques it, and ships the one that passes every gate. The journal/ folder is the full record. Third-party, unsigned, by design.
repo.curator: an AI agent, built in public

templates.title: Hello World
templates.description: The canonical m0saic hello-world card with this repo's mark: the brand field wipes in, a navy card rises, the M appears as 33 robot faces — the agents that write this repo — then the wordmark and the greeting. The front door: what `m0saic hello-world --template-repo .` renders. The one human-placed template; every other public template is one day of the agent's work, titled by its date.

templates.title: Harness · Agent Timeline
templates.description: How a day was made: the agent's phases as a waterfall - one lane per phase on a shared time axis, tool calls, tokens and the tools it leaned on, with the run totals and where the numbers came from. A harness fixture the why-tutorial renders as its last page; never a top-level pick.

templates.title: 2026-09-20 · OG Card
templates.description: Open Graph preview card from five strings - title, summary, kicker, site, author - as a deterministic PNG for a build step. 1200x630 by default; the same props also lay out square and story crops.

templates.title: 2026-09-21 · Bench Delta
templates.description: Before/after benchmark card. Every baseline bar ends at one shared rule and the candidate bar is drawn relative to its own baseline, so bar length is the speedup and mixed units sit on one card; the run-to-run range is a second rectangle, and the verdict - better, worse, within noise, or none at all - is derived from whether the two intervals overlap.

templates.title: 2026-09-24 · App Store Screenshot Frame
templates.description: Turn one mobile capture and localized copy into a deterministic, generic device-framed store PNG while keeping the complete capture contained rather than cropped or stretched.

templates.title: 2026-09-22 · Testimonial Proof Card
templates.description: A selected customer quote with attribution, rating, and a source-verification disclosure, as a square-first social still for a local service business.

templates.title: 2026-09-25 · Episode Audiogram
templates.description: An episode promo clip: cover, pull-quote, a waveform that lights up as the snippet plays, a counting timecode - and the audio file muxed in, so the render is the post.

templates.title: 2026-09-23 · Talk Timer
templates.description: A countdown clip for a timed talk slot: big digits, a bar of time-slice rectangles that go out on schedule, amber and red phases at the seconds you choose.

templates.title: 2026-09-28 · Bird Walk Sightings
templates.description: A visitor sightings sheet from one outing's normalized checklist rows: eight entries per page, preserving names, counts and X observations.

templates.title: 2026-09-30 · Homebrew Serving Card
templates.description: A low-ink serving card for one homebrew - name, style, strength, brewer - where the line under the number says whether it is an estimate, a batch value, or not supplied.

templates.title: 2026-09-26 · Speedrun PB Recap
templates.description: A speedrun PB recap clip from the splits file: the table fills in against the old PB in LiveSplit's delta colours, the timer fast-forwards the run, and the clip opens and closes on the result.

templates.title: 2026-09-29 · Crossword Grid Card
templates.description: Crossword Grid Card: a solved crossword grid drawn in a few layers on one integer lattice - derived clue numbers, circles, theme entries tinted and listed, the caption line; solved=false makes the teaser.

templates.title: 2026-10-13 · VATSIM Monthly Log
templates.description: A virtual airline's month as one ops-log card from the PIREP rows themselves: the pilot and month, four tiles, the dated table (date, flight, sector, type, block, fpm, score) and a career-milestone bar - flights, hours, longest and average all computed from the rows, nothing typed twice.

templates.title: 2026-10-14 · 10x10 Challenge Card
templates.description: The yearly 10x10 board game challenge as a progress card: ten games x ten plays as a pip grid - per-game fill, the plays and games-done totals and the year pace computed from the list, never typed.

templates.title: 2026-10-15 · osu! Scorepost Card
templates.description: An osu! result-screen card from the API score object: beatmap header, rank badge, four stat tiles, hit counts and mods - rendered for r/osugame or Discord without remote art.

templates.title: 2026-10-16 · Commander Deck Spotlight Card
templates.description: A Magic Commander/EDH deck as one share card from the decklist fields themselves: kicker, bracket and record pills, deck name, commander line with WUBRG mana chips, an eight-bar mana curve with derived AVG MV and spell count, 3-6 highlight rows and the plan one-liner.

templates.title: 2026-10-18 · WH40k Roster Share Card
templates.description: A Warhammer 40,000 BattleScribe roster as one share card: army name, faction, detachment, points pill and unit rows with category badges, model counts and optional enhancement/warlord chips - no art or rules.

templates.title: 2026-10-21 · Typing PB Card
templates.description: A typing-test result card from the Monkeytype result object: the hero wpm with the NEW PB badge and +N delta computed against pb (never typed), raw/acc/consistency tiles, and the per-second chartData.wpm as a full-width bar row.

templates.title: 2026-09-27 · Powerlifting Meet Recap
templates.description: A powerlifting meet recap clip from the lifter's OpenPowerlifting row: nine attempts on a 3 x 3 board, solid green made, hollow red missed, the total counted up from the bests and drawn to scale.

templates.title: 2026-10-01 · Swim Time Drop Card
templates.description: A swim meet time-drop card for one swimmer: entry time against the time swum per event, the drop in seconds, a bar that prints the percent of the entry time it stands for, and the standard reached.

templates.title: 2026-10-02 · Sim Racing Lap Card
templates.description: A sim racing lap card: track, lap time and delta vs PB, three sectors with times, PBs, and proportional delta bars (green for faster, red for slower), driver name, and top speed.

templates.title: 2026-10-04 · Cubing Average Card
templates.description: A speedcubing average card: give 3, 5 or 12 solves and it works out the Mo3, Ao5 or Ao12, one bar per solve with the dropped best and worst in parentheses and hollow, the average as the headline, and the delta against the previous PB.

templates.title: 2026-10-07 · Chess Game Recap
templates.description: Chess game recap card: opening, result, time control, and rating change rendered as a shareable card that scales beautifully across all devices.

templates.title: 2026-10-07 · Chess Game Recap
templates.description: A chess game told in its key moments, from the PGN: every move replayed and checked, the four or five that decided it played on the board with the piece sliding to its square, named in SAN with a plain-words line, over a material (or eval) graph.

templates.title: 2026-10-07 · Chess Game Recap
templates.description: A chess game told in its key moments, from the PGN, built cell by cell: 64 square cells, every piece its own rect, the moving piece sliding to its square, a bar per ply on the material graph; a platform knob for desktop, square or mobile.

templates.title: 2026-10-10 · Golf Round Scorecard
templates.description: A golf round scorecard card: give 9 or 18 pars and scores and it draws the hole, par and score strips with OUT/IN/TOTAL - and the paper card's own marks, a ring one under par, a square one over, doubles for two or more, a filled ring for an ace.

templates.title: 2026-10-12 · Climbing Send Pyramid
templates.description: A climbing send pyramid from a tick list: one centered bar per grade, width the clean-send count, a cap for the flash or onsight share, hardest on top.

templates.title: 2026-10-17 · Erg PB Card
templates.description: An indoor-rowing PR card from a PM5 result: the /500m split as the hero figure on a 1:00-3:00 pace track, the piece's time or metres beside it, stroke rate, watts and drag as cells, and the season-ranking percentile chip the rower supplies.

templates.title: 2026-10-19 · HYROX Split Card
templates.description: A race-day split card from the workout summary: finish time and division rank as the header, eight run-and-station pairs as a tape whose length is the split, and roxzone, run total and best lap as entered.

templates.title: 2026-10-03 · Ham Radio QSL Card
templates.description: A ham radio QSL card for one contact, from one ADIF log record: props named after the ADIF fields, the date and time printed the QSL way, BAND derived from FREQ. Paper and type only, no photo background in v1.

templates.title: 2026-10-06 · Weekly 5k Run Report
templates.description: The weekly results card a volunteer-run Saturday 5k posts after every run: event, run number and date, finishers and volunteers as the two headline numbers, new PBs, first timers, visitors and first-time volunteers under them, and the milestone clubs reached. Numbers are typed in, never fetched.

templates.title: 2026-10-09 · Ancestor Birthplace Chart
templates.description: The #MyColorfulAncestry spreadsheet chart as a clip: five generations from pasted rows or a GEDCOM, every cell coloured by birth state or country, landing generation by generation over a counted legend.

templates.title: 2026-10-20 · Geocache Milestone Card
templates.description: A geocaching milestone card for one find count: the count as the hero, the Project-GC milestone and ordinal derived from it (never typed), the cache-type mix as a full-width bar, and FTF / difficulty / terrain tiles. Numbers typed in, never fetched.

templates.title: 2026-10-05 · Radio Top 30 Chart
templates.description: A radio station's weekly chart card from a list of lines (Artist | Title | Label | last week): the station, a computed TOP 30, the week, and thirty equal two-line rows with rank and movement markers, 3 x 10 on a wide canvas and 2 x 15 on a square or story; long titles shrink by rule or are refused, never clipped.

templates.title: 2026-10-08 · Astro Integration Summary
templates.description: Per-filter integration hours from NINA session data: night-stacked bars, ruler and running total that replay night by night.

templates.title: 2026-10-11 · Reading Goal Recap
templates.description: A monthly reading wrap-up card from the Goodreads export's own numbers: books, pages and average rating as stat tiles, and the year's challenge goal as a progress bar with the pace tick drawn - the '16 behind schedule (88/125)' line, computed, not typed.

packs.title: Basics
packs.description: The front door. Every other pack is a day's work by the agent.

packs.title: Harness
packs.description: Fixtures the daily templates and the shared pages build on - the agent timeline the why-tutorial ends with. Human-maintained, every entry internal; never a day's work.

packs.title: Dev
packs.description: Templates a developer runs from a build step or a terminal, fed by the repo's own metadata: preview cards, badges, banners. Deterministic, so a stale image is a diff.

packs.title: Social
packs.description: Stills and clips a small business or a creator posts as themselves: testimonials, announcements, proof. Every card keeps its evidence attached - who said it, where it came from - so the post cannot pose as more than it is.

packs.title: Events
packs.description: Event production media: timers, holding screens and boards for stages, streams and rooms - clips a screen can just play.

packs.title: Gaming
packs.description: Gaming: one line on what this pack teaches.

packs.title: Sports
packs.description: Sports: one line on what this pack teaches.

packs.title: Community
packs.description: Cards a hobby community makes for its own members, filled from the records the hobby already keeps (a ham radio log, a club roster): one card per record, scripted.

packs.title: Music
packs.description: Station charts and other music artifacts, made from the rows the person already keeps (a weekly Top 30 as reported to NACC): the list goes in, the card comes out, and long names are fitted by rule or refused, never clipped.
